description.value:
You've installed a powerful electromagnet in your frame that you can use to move and manipulate items from afar. You can move 1 unattended object of 1 Bulk or less that has the tech trait or is made from metal within 30 feet to anywhere within 30 feet as a single action with the concentrate trait.

In addition, if you attempt to [[/act disarm]] an item with the tech trait or that's made of metal, you don't need to have a hand free, and you can attempt to Disarm at a range of 30 feet.

Special If you have the combatant SRO or worker SRO heritage, the range at which you can move such objects and Disarm such objects increases to 60 feet.
